assumptions.claim: Immutable protocol addresses (quoteToken, vrfWrapper, raffleImplementation) are initialized and non-zero before _validateCreateParams reads them at L158-L159 and L164-L166.
params.endTime is strictly greater than block.timestamp and within MAX_SALE_DURATION (not checked by _validateCreateParams).

params.sponsorRecipient is not the address of the newly created Raffle clone itself (which is not yet deployed or registered in isRaffle when _validateCreateParams runs at L98/L166) and params.prizeToken is not protocolTreasury.

params.prizeToken is a standards-compliant, non-malicious ERC-721 contract beyond having non-empty bytecode (L155, L184) and returning true from IERC165.supportsInterface(type(IERC721).interfaceId) (L172-L177).

params.sponsorRecipient is not an undeployed address that will later be deployed and registered as a Raffle clone by this RaffleFactory (which would cause isRaffle[sponsorRecipient] to become true at RaffleFactory.sol:L125 and make Raffle._isProtocolDestination return true during Raffle._transferQuote at Raffle.sol:L565, L602-L603).
params.reserveEntries requires no upper bound below type(uint128).max (only params.reserveEntries != 0 is checked at L178).

calls.propagates: Reverts with NotContract(params.prizeToken) if params.prizeToken.code.length == 0 (L184); on return, establishes params.prizeToken.code.length > 0 and params.prizeToken != address(0) (L155, L184).

Called via STATICCALL (due to view modifier at L154) with type(IERC721).interfaceId (0x80ac58cd) and no explicit gas cap (L172); reverts with UnsupportedPrizeToken(params.prizeToken) if the call reverts (L174-L176) or returns false (L177), or reverts in ABI decoding if return data is malformed; establishes only that params.prizeToken returned true for 0x80ac58cd, not full ERC-721 behavioral compliance.

invariants.claim: On normal return, params.prizeToken has non-empty deployed bytecode (params.prizeToken.code.length > 0) and is non-zero.
On normal return, params.sponsorRecipient is not address(0).
On normal return, params.prizeToken is not address(this), quoteToken, vrfWrapper, raffleImplementation, or any address currently mapped to true in isRaffle.
On normal return, params.sponsorRecipient is not address(this), quoteToken, vrfWrapper, params.prizeToken, raffleImplementation, or any address currently mapped to true in isRaffle.
On normal return, IERC165(params.prizeToken).supportsInterface(type(IERC721).interfaceId) succeeded via STATICCALL and returned true.
